description: Four small plastic plates—green, yellow, red, and blue—sit spread out on a green tablecloth near the corner. The right hand slides the yellow plate left onto the green plate to stack them, then lifts and sets the red plate onto the yellow, and finally lifts the blue plate and places it on top of the stack; the right-hand object changes from yellow to red to blue as each plate is picked up and released, while the left hand stays out of view.
